nodes.label: SEMD Auth UI Mockup (Login/Register/2FA)
nodes.rationale: Filename suffix .tmp and an embedded dev-nav debug switcher (Login/Register/2FA Login/2FA Setup buttons) indicate this is a throwaway static HTML prototype, not a wired Next.js page. It establishes the amber/brown brand palette, Thai-language copy, animal mascot branding, and an OTP + QR-code multi-factor auth UX pattern intended to guide later production implementation of the (auth) route group.
